parameters: *Ahem.*  Not so fast, \P[1].  Come on now, you know your manners, as well as how your parents run their household, young man.
You can't just go running inside, with no head on your neck, and your neck's severed top dripping, getting blood inside the house and
all over the carpet...  You parents are very adamant about this, and so are their household staff, because both your parents make them.
You'd best behave and have your head on your neck before you open the door.
No exceptions, that's what your parents insist on.  You know that, \P[1], its always been that way.  Doesn't matter if you've been swordfighting
in the back yard with friends, or what you've been up to.  No you will not just sneak in anyways.  Yes you have to.  You ALWAYS have to, \P[1].
If your nutrition (Special Points) happens to be too low, then use an intercom or phone to call your butler, Frank.
You can find intercoms and phones in the shops to the north, on your parents' property, thank you.

and so does your girlfriend who lives with you and your family, \P[2], both of which are tied to your Mom and Dad's bank accounts, who check
the statements and monitor stuff all the time as routine.  You and \P[2] are normally allowed to use the ATMs, within reason.  Once in a while
the rest of your family uses them.  The household staff use them all the time, saving them trips to the bank.

Ronald (Your Fighting Trainer)
You see Ronald, your personal fighting trainer, who helps you with practice and homework assignments for fighting class at school.
Ever since the early 29th century worldwide monster invasions that led to the countryside and places between cities and towns being infested
with monsters, super-dangerous versions of wild animals, and fantasy creatures, townspeople and citizenry world-wide had to learn how to
fight.  Krulickhe is no exception.  Kids learn combat magic and swordfighting in public schools now, for generations.
